items.description: I Am Busy Digging a Hole– and you'll be busy too!Grab your shovel and discover what treasures lie beneath the surface in this delightful digging adventure. The deeper you go, the more exciting your journey becomes.Dig through layers of earth to find valuable ores that you can sell for upgrades. Make your shovel stronger and your backpack bigger as you continue your busy digging life. Along the way, uncover rare dragons and ancient coins hiding in the dirt.Each dragon you rescue finds a home in your yard, creating a lively community above ground. And for those who dig deep enough, rumors of a mysterious cave dweller might lead to undiscovered worlds.Features:Colorful Underground – Explore a vibrant world beneath your feet with surprises at every depth.Rewarding Progression – Sell ore, upgrade equipment, and watch your digging skills improve.Dragon Collection – Build a unique dragon sanctuary in your yard with each new discovery.Hidden Mysteries – Some secrets are buried deeper than others, waiting for the most determined diggers.Relaxing Experience – Get busy digging at your own pace in this charming underground adventure. items.description: Jump from platform to platform in this minimalist puzzle platformer. All platforms except your starting platform move at different speeds, some even carry the coveted token. In addition to the speed, the platforms may differ in size and this brings a challenge to the gameplay. And don't stay on the platforms for too long, otherwise you will lose if you touch the edges of the screen. Collect a lot of tokens and good luck with your game. items.description: Step into the enigmatic world of "Enigma Quest" a captivating puzzle-adventure game set within the sprawling halls of a mysterious museum. You, the Seeker, embark on a journey through intricate mazes, cryptic puzzles, and corridors steeped in history. As you navigate this immersive world, you'll uncover the stories of brilliant minds who once dared to unlock the secrets of the museum's enigma but were lost within its depths. Their echoes guide your path as you strive to solve puzzles, decode enigmas, and piece together the narrative of their ambitions. The heart of the museum holds the ultimate challenge—an enigma that transcends the boundaries of thought. Will you unravel its secrets, or will you too become a part of the enigma's legacy? "Enigma: Echoes of the Past" beckons you to embark on a quest for understanding, a journey where curiosity knows no bounds. With a captivating storyline, challenging puzzles, and a richly detailed environment, "Enigma: Echoes of the Past" promises an adventure that will test your wits, immerse you in a world of wonder, and leave you pondering the mysteries of the past. items.description: Help little Jorji to survive in his journey to the depths of Impossible Forest, in this super-hard, hand-crafted 2D platformer.Impossible Forest was a very peaceful place, filled with cute inhabitants. But once upon a cruel wizard called Nemrok curses this place with wretched charms, placing seeds of evil into every living soul of Impossible Forest, even into "the Guardians of the forest" - the long-lived protectors of the forest.You are playing as forester boy, named "Little Jorji" - the one who has an immunity to the evil wizard's charms. The controls are very simple - jump, air-dash, shoot, climb - but levels will become hard very fast and your every fail will be a lesson. Fast respawns, puzzles and crafty enemies will make your journey even more fun. Your main aim will be to purge evil forces from the Impossible Forest, making it peaceful again, while understanding why Nemrok has such an interest in this place ?
